mainEntity.name: What kind of results can I expect from AI Website Optimization?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can expect improved visibility in AI-powered search results, including increased appearances in featured snippets, direct answer boxes, and voice search responses. This often leads to higher organic traffic, better engagement with your content, and an enhanced brand authority as your site becomes a go-to source for answers. While traditional SEO metrics are still important, AEO specifically aims to capture the growing segment of users interacting with AI search interfaces, leading to more qualified leads and conversions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Expect improved visibility in AI-powered search, increased featured snippet appearances, higher organic traffic, and enhanced brand authority, leading to more qualified leads.
